evidence: GSC API, 2026-09-15 through 2026-10-12 (28 days), supported by 2026-07-15 through 2026-10-12 (90 days). Raw country/query/page evidence and the per-query classification table are retained in a private deliverable.

rules.method: Semantic internal links, explicit service headings and Service aliases; never query/referrer-dependent HTTP redirects
rules.language: Infer query language from lexical evidence. Country is a measured market dimension, not a language selector. Ambiguous queries remain reviewable.
rules.protected: Homepages retain self-canonicals, title/H1, brand and general photographer/city intent. Generic portfolio is ambiguous and is not a photography-service query by itself.
rules.scope: No new service offer for boudoir, product, family, baby, real-estate, wedding or training terms inferred from search exposure. Fine Art does not imply nudity.
rules.ranking: Target owner is a declared preference, not proof of Google result replacement. Keep all URLs indexable and measure after release.
